about: Curated traversal for the shooter map graphs in maps.json: node levels (0 = ground) and typed links. Types: walk, stairs, ladder, door, vent, breakable, drop (one-way down), teleport (one-way). 'retype' changes an existing edge; 'add' adds a link. Facts from the Valorant and Counter-Strike Fandom wikis (CC BY-SA), checked 21 Nov 2026. The graphs are simplified 2D callout networks, not official geometry.

valorant:bind.source: https://valorant.fandom.com/wiki/Bind — 'two one-way teleporters. One takes players from A Short to B Short and the other takes players from B Long to A Lobby.'

valorant:lotus.source: https://valorant.fandom.com/wiki/Lotus — rotating doors toggled from either side (10 s rotation); a destructible wall (400 HP) between A Main and A Link; a silenced drop from A Top to A Drop.

valorant:haven.source: https://valorant.fandom.com/wiki/Haven — three bomb sites (A, B, C).

cs2:nuke.source: https://counterstrike.fandom.com/wiki/Nuke — two levels: Upper A and Lower B joined by Ramp, Secret stairs and the vents between the sites (vent covers can be opened and closed); Heaven above A.
